title: Austin Energy & Green Building Program Updates
summary:
*   Received a final report from the Green Building Task Force, outlining recommendations to boost participation in the city's green building program.
*   Heard a comprehensive financial and operational report from Austin Energy, the city's power utility.
*   Discussed, in executive session, a proposed policy for Austin Energy to manage energy risks, impacting its competitive operations.
